findings.title: Headless render latency (8226ms) exceeds crawl time budget on /
findings.evidence: Hydration and DOM stabilization took 8226ms (threshold: 4500ms). Real-world AI crawlers (OAI-SearchBot) operate on strict 3-5 second timeouts and drop slow-rendering pages.

suggested_action.summary: Optimize client bundle size, defer non-critical scripts, or implement server-side pre-rendering to keep time-to-content under 3.5 seconds.
